name: Fill
description: Fill/: the suite's one gradient model. Fill, GradientStop and FillColor as FlareCore's Fill, GradientStop and Color under kernel names, FillType (solid, linear, radial), FillSelection (a fill and its box) and the GradientFillTarget protocol an app's workspace conforms to; GradientRules (the stop, angle and box rules: maxStops, stopHelp, converted, angle, rotated, color, adding, moving, removing and recolouring stops, mapped); GradientIntent (the gradient editor's gestures, each one fill.* command and its params) and GradientCommands (the eight fill.* command specs every app registers: fill.read, fill.type, fill.gradient, fill.stop-add, fill.stop-move, fill.stop-remove, fill.stop-color and fill.angle, each edit one undo step named for its command, a stop or angle drag folded into one step by its drag token); GradientSVG (a fill as an SVG gradient definition). The commands run on the fake canvas (FakeCanvasDocument) and behind SuiteUI's GradientEditor, whose gallery page sends each intent through them on a live local target with a History. gradient-fill GF-1 declared them; GF-5 to GF-10 built them. The suite's one stroke model sits beside it: VectorStroke, StrokeJoin and StrokeCap as FlareCore's Stroke under kernel names, and DashPreset (solid, dashed, dotted, custom); StrokeRules (the width limits, the dash presets scaled by width, and paintedPath, the path a stroke paints, trimmed then dashed with FlareCore's path ops); the StrokeTarget protocol, StrokeIntent (the stroke editor's gestures) and StrokeCommands (the nine stroke.* command specs every app registers: stroke.read, stroke.add, stroke.color, stroke.width, stroke.join, stroke.cap, stroke.dash, stroke.trim and stroke.remove, each edit one undo step, a width or trim drag folded into one); StrokeSVG (a stroke as SVG presentation attributes). They run on the fake canvas and behind SuiteUI's StrokeEditor, whose gallery page sends each intent through them on a live local target. stroke-style SS-1 declared them; SS-5 to SS-10 built them.
technology: Swift 6, Foundation (FoundationEssentials) and FlareCore, Linux and macOS
